task: Retire the skill_first_guard PreToolUse hook from both the Claude and vendored Copilot surfaces per ADR-085 decision D-A: Copilot CLI ignores repo-committed permissions, so the guard cannot intercept raw gh/git calls on the surface we ship to customers, making it net-negative. No git-observable invariant corresponds to the guard's steering, so pre-execution blocking is retired, not relocated (issue #3217, epic #3197).

events.content: Removed skill_first_guard from the Claude source: deleted the hook script and its three registration surfaces (dispatch_groups.json group, settings.json matcher, plugin hooks.json dispatcher entry).

Regenerated the vendored Copilot surface with build_all.py: dropped the skill_first_guard shim, its _manifest.json entry, the vendored hooks.json registration, and refreshed the vendored SKILL.md and list_issues.py copies.

Deleted the two guard-only test modules and surgically removed guard references from three shared tests (hook plugin guards parametrize case, list_issues #2110 guard-mapping class, pr-description example filename).

Repointed the agent-harness-reference SKILL.md evidence citations off the doomed guard onto durable survivors (generate_hooks_shim.py for the stdin alias contract, invoke_security_gate.py for exit-2 and lib-bootstrap) and updated stale live-doc references in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/github-api-capabilities.md.
Bumped the project-toolkit plugin manifests 0.6.92 -> 0.6.93 on both surfaces to satisfy the parity gate.
